name: preflight_probe
description: Ask whether Scubiee MCP is available
prompt: You are a short diagnostic agent. Use Scubiee MCP tools if available. Answer ONLY with a compact JSON object: {"scubiee_available":bool,"tools_seen":[...],"gate":str,"map_ok":bool,"notes":str}. Call gate then map with query "scubiee pack_context composite tracer engine visibility" k=5. Do not edit files.
